article.title: At the UN Trump threatens to use “unmatched military power” in Latin America
article.author: Editor
article.content: “The United States will no longer allow threats against the Americas to gain ground anywhere in the Western Hemisphere. And, if necessary, we will use our unmatched military might to secure the vital national interests of the United States,” Trump said. The post At the UN Trump threatens to use “unmatched military power” in Latin America appeared first on MR Online .
